主要内容: On May 14, 2013, DISH Network Corporation announced its subsidiary DISH DBS Corporation's intention to offer approximately $2.5 billion in senior notes, subject to market conditions. The notes will be offered to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Proceeds will be placed in escrow to finance a portion of the cash consideration for the proposed merger with Sprint Nextel Corporation. If the merger does not occur by the escrow end date, DISH DBS will redeem the notes. DISH DBS stated it had multiple meetings with Sprint's advisors and senior management.
